name: EcoPulse
description: Browser-based ecosystem simulator where simple rules create emergent life. Grass grows, prey feed and herd, predators hunt in packs, traits evolve through natural selection, seasons shift, and optional human civilization builds roads and bridges that reshape the whole world.
highlights: Full predator–prey ecosystem with inherited traits and natural selection
Seasons, migration, terrain biomes and environmental disturbances
Optional human civilisation — hunting, huts, roads and bridges

name: DailyHub
description: Personal dashboard for your daily puzzle ritual. Pick your games, log results with one paste, track streaks, and review every run in a calendar history view.
highlights: Tracks Wordle, NYT, LinkedIn Games and more
Streak system, progress stats, and calendar history
Fully local — no account, no backend

name: AntLab
description: Browser sandbox for emergent simulations. Runs pheromone-driven ant colonies, multi-species Physarum slime mold, and generative art modes — all in real time with live parameter controls.
highlights: Ant colony foraging, Physarum slime mold, and generative art
Up to 6 000 agents with live behaviour controls
Runs entirely in the browser with no backend

name: SAP Navigator
description: The search engine built for SAP professionals. Find any T-code by plain language, decode errors into actionable next steps, look up standard tables, and follow guided process flows — all offline, no login needed.
highlights: 16 500+ transactions searchable by keyword or plain language
Error decoder with likely cause and numbered next steps
PWA — installs on any device, works fully offline

name: Excel Merger
description: Client-side web tool for merging multiple Excel files into a single workbook with separate tabs. Designed for fast, safe workflows without uploads.
highlights: Runs fully in the browser
No file uploads or server processing
Fast and simple workflow

name: Work Time Calculator
description: Lightweight time calculation tool built for everyday use. Optimized for quick edits, keyboard input, and easy copy-paste.
highlights: Minimal and distraction-free UI
Fast input and editing
Easy to extend and customize

name: AI Answer and Transcript
description: Browser-based tool for capturing audio, generating transcripts, and producing AI-powered answers in real time. Built to explore practical voice-to-AI workflows.
highlights: Live transcription workflow
AI-generated answers from audio input
Client-focused, experimental setup

name: Polen Dashboard
description: Interactive dashboard for visualizing environmental and pollen-related data. Built as part of a larger pollen monitoring and data collection project.
highlights: Real-time and historical data views
Clean, readable visualizations
Built to support sensor-based data pipelines

name: Compare code program
description: Local web-based tool for comparing code and structured text files side by side. Built to support review, validation, and change tracking workflows.
highlights: Side-by-side comparison view
Fast local processing
Useful for review and validation tasks

name: MoneyCounter
description: Simple visual tool that shows earnings accumulating in real time based on salary input. Built as a motivational and UX-focused experiment.
highlights: Real-time animated counter
Clean and focused UI
Built for clarity and motivation

name: Data Hub
description: Central web hub for collecting and presenting sensor and environmental data. Part of the broader pollen monitoring system.
highlights: Centralized data presentation
Built to support live sensor input
Designed as part of a larger system
